title: Genie Agents enhancements
body:
* **SQL function descriptions**: When a SQL function is attached as a tool, you can now view the function's description. See [How does Genie use SQL functions?](/aws/en/genie-agents/tune-quality#sql-functions).
* **Upgraded chat-mode models**: Genie Agents chat mode now uses upgraded large language models.

ref_links.text: How does Genie use SQL functions?
